description.value:
You have learned to read a second sky behind the first, and to stand in both at once.

Choose a second Gold Cloth constellation during your daily preparations. Until your next preparations, you are also treated as a Saint of that constellation for the purpose of which days are yours — but not for its Techniques, passive, or Cloth Ability.

On a day your chosen second constellation is ascendant, you gain your own Ascendant Boon. If it rises Exalted, you gain your own Ascendant Boon, not your Zenith Boon: the second sky wakes your Cloth but cannot exalt it.

This roughly doubles the frequency of your Ascendant days, from 1 in 13 to 2 in 13.

Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.

rules.prompt: Which second sky do you read today?
